jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position in Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute, The University of Southern Denmark in Sønderborg, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a postdoctoral research associate in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and (Photo)electrochemistry, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, a part of MCI, and it is integrated into the novel, active working group CatMatX, a research laboratory focused on developing next-generation catalytic materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications,  by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing project proposals to support research at SDU NanoSYD. 

Job Description and Responsibilities

• 
Implementation of research tasks related to the project;

• 
Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, and evaluation of materials performance in solar water splitting;

• 
Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results;

• 
Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.;

• 
Publishing of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals with high impact factors.

Potential Responsibilities 

• 
Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics; 

• 
Assistance in teaching activities; 

• 
Assistance in setting up the research infrastructure;

• 
Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding. 

Mandatory qualifications 

• 
PhD degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, Electrochemistry, or related fields; 

• 
Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds;

• 
Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM);   

• 
Proven track record of publishing in international peer-reviewed scientific journals as leading author;

• 
Fluency in English (both spoken and written);

• 
Ability to work in teams and also independently; 

• 
Strong communication skills; 

• 
Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry. 

The following qualifications are advantageous

• 
Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities, DFT calculations and MD simulations;

• 
Research experience in electrochemistry and solar water splitting; 

• 
Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project; 

• 
Proven record in participating in national and international research projects;

• 
Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group.

Contact information

For more information about the department and the position, please contact Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk) and Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and it starts on 01.03.2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

To qualify for the position as postdoc you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s previous research work and experience most relevant to the offered position.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Certificates/Diplomas (Bachelor, Master, and PhD degrees) – Danish and/or English transcripts. 

• 
Complete list of publications (please highlight publications most relevant to the offered position).

• 
Research statement on developing novel transition metal-based mixed anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting.

• 
A reference letter may be submitted, but is not required. 

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is October 31, 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST).

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

jobs.occupation: Industrial Painter
jobs.description:
Industrial Painter Wanted for Give Steel A/S

Do you have experience with surface treatment of steel structures? Are you skilled in spray painting and using airless pump equipment? And do you thrive in a busy work environment where quality and safety are top priorities?

If so, Give Steel A/S is looking for an Industrial Painter to join our painting department in Brande.

You will become part of an international company specialising in the surface treatment of large steel structures. Our painting department operates 24/7 throughout the week, while your position will primarily be on the day shift.

Why Choose Us?

We continuously develop and improve our production processes and utilise modern equipment for surface treatment and fire protection coatings. You will have access to state-of-the-art facilities, including newly built paint halls with advanced ventilation systems and a new water-based paint application facility.

We prioritise a safe and positive working environment and value teamwork, mutual respect, and strong social relationships.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will be responsible for spray painting steel structures using primarily airless pump equipment. We focus on using modern technology and equipment to support efficient production processes.

Safety is a key aspect of surface treatment work. You will therefore receive thorough training in safety procedures as well as the handling of waste materials and residues generated during the painting process.

Your Primary Responsibilities

You will work with:

• Surface treatment of large steel structures.

• Spray painting using primarily airless pump equipment.

• Following established safety procedures.

• Handling waste materials and residues from the surface treatment process.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a reliable and team-oriented employee with experience in the surface treatment of steel structures.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a valid epoxy certificate.

• Have experience with surface treatment of steel structures.

• Have experience using airless pump equipment.

• Thrive in a fast-paced work environment.

• Work well as part of a team.

• Speak and write either Danish or English.

What We Offer

• Skilled and supportive colleagues.

• A positive work environment with a strong focus on safety and well-being.

• A workplace built on strong social values.

• Private health insurance.

• Canteen scheme and additional employee benefits.

• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

• Fitness facilities and massage services.

Practical Information

• Working hours: Full-time position on the day shift.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Location: Give Steel A/S, Sjællandsvej 14, 7330 Brande, Denmark.

Would You Like to Join the Team?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact the Painting Department Team Leader, Kenneth Helmuth Thomassen,  +45 66 50 77 44

Please submit your CV and clearly state your relevant experience.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and the job posting will be removed once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company specialising in the design, engineering, production, and installation of load-bearing steel structures and steel roof trusses.

Quality, safety, and documentation are integral parts of our daily work. We also focus on climate considerations, material selection, and documentation throughout both the engineering and production processes.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and excellent opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our everyday work.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
jobs.description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

• 
Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

• 
Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

• 
Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

• 
Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

• 
A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

• 
A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

• 
An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

• 
Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

• 
Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

• 
A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

• 
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

• 
30 days of paid holiday per year

• 
The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

• 
Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

• 
Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

• 
In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

• 
Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

• 
Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

• 
Brief motivation letter

• 
Curriculum vitae

• 
Full list of publications

• 
Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

• 
Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

• 
Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

Technically grounded

Structured and organized

-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.

-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design

Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success

Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
